Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the 1985 telefilm as a Hallmark Hall of Fame production (it was a PBS WonderWorks telefilm), which led to misleading search queries and introduced conflated results (e.g., New Zealand references tied to the 2007 film). This early mislabeling seeded confusion and contributed to conflicting information later in the process.
